Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
Dominaria United is on the way! To celebrate the return to Magic’s oldest plane, we’ve got a museum-ready collection of stained-glass foil Showcase cards featuring none other than the original five Elder Dragons. That’s right—the legendary Legends and the commanders of Commander, gloriously rendered in the kind of prismatic perfection you’d want as windows for a big old building. Plus there’s that little rascal named like, Nicole Bogus? Nickle Bobo? Eh, he probably wasn’t important.

Contents:
• 1x Textured Foil Showcase Stained Glass Arcades Sabboth
• 1x Textured Foil Showcase Stained Glass Chromium
• 1x Textured Foil Showcase Stained Glass Nicol Bolas
• 1x Textured Foil Showcase Stained Glass Vaevictis Asmadi
• 1x Textured Foil Showcase Stained Glass Palladia-Mors
